cards.when: cue is strict prefix of multiple lemmas (e.g. кор) and correct is single full word
cards.on_fail: Use teacher_rule_only OR lexical_ask with scene; never strengthen oracle lemma

cards.check: teacher move = lexical_ask, not ortho/morph recast
cards.on_pass: hippo question episode; sleep pending until answer

cards.check: scene + correction_kind; babble and correct share committed intent
